items.en_title: São José da Bela Vista (SP) Works & infrastructure procurement · electronic competitive bidding (concorrência) · closes Dec 14 #7
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in São José da Bela Vista (SP) is procuring works, repairs or infrastructure services through electronic competitive bidding (concorrência), with an estimated value of about R$ 4,849,857.40; proposals close Dec 14, 09:30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
